name: Tobari
source:
[i]"If I were mad enough to set the Great Taiju's realm on fire, do you think I would have any problem with killing a lone woman?"[/i]

Despite his young age, he is the current head of the entertainment district. While he may be unfriendly and takes an aggressive attitude toward others, he is quite the caretaker and is admired by the entertainment district residents. He is also the leader of the Shiranui, a rebel group.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/itehari/characters/]Aksys Games[/url]]
